query:
SELECT
            epp.provider,
            epp.page_kind,
            epp.address,
            pp.fetched_at,
            pp.is_dead,
            pp.missing_since
        FROM episode_provider_page epp
        JOIN provider_page pp
          ON pp.provider = epp.provider
         AND pp.page_kind = epp.page_kind
         AND pp.address = epp.address
        WHERE epp.episode_id = $1
        ORDER BY epp.provider, epp.address
